raw_text:
Scheme Name: HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth
Fund House: HDFC Mutual Fund
Source URL: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-small-cap-fund-direct-growth
Category: Equity - Small Cap Fund
Plan Type: Direct Plan - Growth Option
Net Asset Value (NAV): ₹156.58 as of mid-November 2026 (subject to daily fluctuation at market close).
Expense Ratio: 0.79% (inclusive of GST, as published on official scheme factsheet).
Exit Load: Exit load of 1.00% applies if units are redeemed or switched out within 1 year (365 days) from allotment. Nil exit load after 1 year.
Minimum SIP Investment: ₹100 per installment.
Minimum Lumpsum Investment: ₹100 for initial or additional purchase.
Lock-in Period: Nil. This is an open-ended equity fund with no statutory lock-in period.
Riskometer Level: Very High Risk. Investors understand that their principal will be at very high risk.
Benchmark: BSE 250 SmallCap Total Return Index (TRI).
Investment Objective: To provide long-term capital appreciation / income by predominantly investing in equity & equity-related instruments of small-cap companies (companies ranked 251st onwards in terms of full market capitalization).
Tax Implications: Taxed as an equity mutual fund scheme. STCG on redemption within 12 months is taxed at 20%. LTCG on redemption after 12 months is taxed at 12.5% on gains exceeding ₹1.25 Lakh per financial year.
Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA): CAMS (Computer Age Management Services Ltd.), website: www.camsonline.com.
Last updated from sources: November 2026.
